page.notes: The Latin and Italic entries are copied as printed; the page numbers are in the right-hand column of each line. A small smudge sits over the "r" of "Libertate" in the entry "De Libertate creaturae intellectualis in genere". The word is read as Libertate with [?] not needed, since the letters are clear enough. The digitiser's stamp at the bottom right and the edge marks at the top and bottom were left out.
